summary: Backend AI Research Assistant is fully functional (11/11 pytest passing incl. plan → execute → interpretation flow, upload/CSV SMILES extraction, intent chat/followup/plan, CRUD, auth guard, and regressions). Frontend /research workspace is COMPLETELY BROKEN due to a double '/api/api/' URL prefix bug — every research endpoint returns 404 in the browser. As a result none of the Phase-1/Phase-2 UI features (project list, plan card, execute, viz panel, interpretation) can be exercised end-to-end from the UI. Existing pages (/, /phytonet, /phytonet-ai, /plant-database) still render.

minor.issue: Wrapper calls GET /api/disease/search with param 'query' but the endpoint requires 'q' (routes/disease.py line 16). Any plan whose Claude output selects disease_search will 422. Also passes 'limit' which the endpoint does not accept.

ui_bugs.issue: All research API calls hit '/api/api/research/*' → 404. authApi in /app/frontend/src/context/AuthContext.jsx sets baseURL=`${REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL}/api`, but ResearchWorkspace.jsx prepends '/api/' again in ~12 places (authApi.get('/api/research/projects'), authApi.post('/api/research/projects/{pid}/message'), etc.). Fix: drop the leading '/api' from every research URL in ResearchWorkspace.jsx (should be '/research/projects', '/research/projects/${pid}/message', etc.). Verified in browser: fetch('/api/api/research/projects')→404, fetch('/api/research/projects')→200.

Task spec expects data-testid values workspace, sidebar, suggested-prompt-*, new-research-btn. Actual code uses research-workspace, research-sidebar, suggestion-{i}, research-new-project. Consider aligning names or updating the spec — either way the elements exist.

rca of the issue: authApi (axios instance in AuthContext.jsx) has baseURL = `${REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL}/api`. ResearchWorkspace.jsx calls authApi.get('/api/research/projects') → axios concatenates baseURL + path → `${BACKEND}/api/api/research/projects` → FastAPI has no such route → 404. Reproduce: open /research authenticated → observe 'Not Found' toast + Uncaught runtime error overlay. In devtools Network, all XHR to /api/api/research/* return 404. Mitigation: drop the leading '/api' in ResearchWorkspace.jsx paths (or drop it from authApi.baseURL — but that would break every other consumer). Recommendation: fix in ResearchWorkspace.jsx only.
